overview: CareerCompass India is a comprehensive career guidance platform for Indian engineering graduates covering 114+ IT job roles across 10 categories. Features include free courses in English, Hindi, and Telugu, interactive mock tests with scoring, sample interview questions at 3 difficulty levels, a gamified 35-question career quiz, salary progression tables, and a 100+ company directory.
features: Free courses in English, Hindi, and Telugu from NPTEL, Coursera, Udemy, GUVI, and more
Interactive MCQ mock tests at Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced levels with instant scoring
Sample interview questions at 3 levels with expandable talking points
35-question gamified career quiz using O*NET RIASEC and MBTI frameworks
Salary progression tables from Fresher to Architect/Expert
100+ company directory with sector and type filtering
Role-specific job portal links for LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and Internshala
